proposals.before: In the first month of Qianhua 2, the court proclaimed: "On Lantern Festival night, every market and ward may hang colored lamps; the Gold Crow need not enforce the curfew."
proposals.after: In the first month of Qianhua 2, the court proclaimed: "On Lantern Festival night, every market and ward may hang colored lamps; the Jinwu need not enforce the curfew."
proposals.reason: 金吾 is the Jinwu (capital guard) office, not a "Gold Crow".

proposals.before: In the first month of Qianhua 2, an announcement stated: "On the Lantern Festival night, let every market and ward hang colored lamps; the Gold Crow need not enforce the curfew."
proposals.after: In the first month of Qianhua 2, an announcement stated: "On the Lantern Festival night, let every market and ward hang colored lamps; the Jinwu need not enforce the curfew."
proposals.reason: 金吾 is the Jinwu office title, mistranslated as Gold Crow.

proposals.before: At his death the Emperor mourned at length, sent Luoyuan commissioner Cao Shoucong to condole, and cancelled court for the sixth through eighth; chancellor and officials filed condolence at the Upper Gate.
proposals.after: At his death the Emperor mourned at length, sent Luoyuan commissioner Cao Shoudang to condole, and cancelled court for the sixth through eighth; chancellor and officials filed condolence at the Upper Gate.
proposals.reason: 璫 is dàng; Cao Shoucong misreads 曹守璫.

decisions.reason: Focus unit 金吾不用禁夜 names the Jinwu capital-guard office that enforced the night curfew; "Gold Crow" is a false character-by-character reading. Jinwu is the correct office title.
Same focus unit 金吾不用禁夜; literal "Gold Crow" mistranslates the Jinwu office. The proposed Jinwu reading matches the Chinese.
Focus unit names 曹守璫; 璫 is dàng, so Cao Shoucong is a misreading. Cao Shoudang is the correct personal name.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0003 shows English Cao Shoucong came only from misreading 璫; the name claim must use Cao Shoudang while keeping zh, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
